bio.text: Bob Chew is a candidate for U.S. Senate in Colorado in 2026, running on the Forward Party line.

According to his campaign website, he graduated from Case Western Reserve University with a degree in chemical engineering and spent five years on active duty as a division officer aboard a nuclear attack submarine in the Navy.
The site says he later served in the Navy Reserves as an intelligence officer, co-founded an engineering services company in 1996, sold it to its employees, and moved to Boulder, Colorado, in 2017.
